needs_manual_review_reason: Live GEO verification (2026-07-11) confirms exactly 10 GSM samples, series title/summary/design all state 'n=10 primary Meningioma WHO grade III', and one spot-checked GSM (GSM4518075) confirms 'who grade: III' in its characteristics field. Linked publication PMID 33167358 (Dunn et al., Cancers 2020) confirmed via PubMed esummary; this same paper also reuses GSE74385 (also in this inventory as gse-74385-schmidt-expression-array) for its transcriptomic/proteomic integration analysis, so related_accessions/paired_multimodal cross-reference that record; the two datasets are not the same cohort (different sample sets, different submitting labs) so this is a shared-publication link, not a multi-omic pairing of the same patients -- tags.multi_modal_matched is left false accordingly, only paired_multimodal.related_datasets notes the shared-publication relationship for a human to review. Sex/age/location/tissue-preservation not present in series-level metadata; not independently checked per-GSM given the small, single-grade nature of this cohort. large_cohort left false pending centralized quartile recomputation.
